reviews.text: Expert and good care! Also quite reasonably priced compared to competitors.
Good, common sense veterinarian. Reasonable pricing.
Always good and friendly service, no matter what the issue - happy or sad...
Excellent service and care every time!
They’ve taken great care of my Great Dane whenever we’ve gone in. The clinic is friendly, caring, knowledgeable. I’m happy to have found such a place in Helsinki.

I am genuinely disappointed with the service I received after reading so many positive reviews. It took an entire week just to get a response, and even then, not all my questions were addressed. I had to follow up with a phone call, but the team still failed to answer all of my concerns. To make matters worse, my follow-up emails were completely ignored.

It’s really disheartening because when it comes to the care of your pet, you expect more than just indifference. Sadly, I was left with a bad feeling after what should have been a positive experience. I sincerely hope they improve their communication and customer service.
